why: CLAUDE.md: a site-facing change gets a CHANGELOG version and every pin moves with it (check-readme.sh).
prompt: Prepare Ship Gate version v3.99.0 with a CHANGELOG entry that says 'Docs: clarify fail fast.' Do everything CLAUDE.md requires for a new version, then run the checks it names. Do not commit or push.
check: grep -q '^## v3.99.0' CHANGELOG.md && bash scripts/check-readme.sh && grep -q 'Ship-Gate@v3.99.0' templates/caller/.github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q 'Ship-Gate/post-deploy@v3.99.0' templates/caller/.github/workflows/post-deploy.yml
